benefits.text:
hince True Dimension Radiance Balm is a glow balm stick that helps create a naturally light-catching, radiant and dewy skin effect, like light shining from within. The soft, smooth balm texture glides on easily and is easy to tap onto the high points of the face such as the cheekbones, bridge of the nose, brow bone or cheeks to add a subtle sheen without making the makeup layer too heavy. Clear colors combined with finely milled pearl help the face look brighter, softer and more dimensional; suitable to use with a matte base for a subtle inner glow or with a glow base to boost a radiant pearlescent glow.

True Dimension Radiance Balm is one of hince's standout highlighter lines, with many achievements recorded in the brand's materials. It has sold more than 2.3 million units cumulatively, with an average of more than 1,000 units sold per day, and is recorded as the No.1 Highlighter according to the data in the materials. The line has also won Glowpick Awards 9 consecutive times, ranking No.1 in the Cream/Stick Highlighter category at the 2025 Glowpick Awards and No.1 in the Highlighter category at the 2024 Hwahae Awards. These achievements help reinforce Radiance Balm's image as hince's signature glow/highlighter product, loved for its soft light-catching effect, ease of use and suitability for many makeup styles.

The Chill Voyage Limited Package is the summer limited edition of the True Dimension Radiance Balm line, with a watery blue design inspired by cool summer air and silvery light on ocean waves. The limited set features 2 of hince's top shades: TP001 Clear and TP005 Shelly Pink. TP001 Clear is a transparent, colorless glow, suitable for creating a natural sheen on many skin tones and many makeup looks. TP005 Shelly Pink has a pure pink tone that creates a fresh, radiant glowing-cheek effect, suited to cool-tone and neutral-tone makeup. Both shades keep the easy-to-use, touch-up-friendly spirit and are collectible thanks to the limited Chill Voyage packaging.

howToUse.text: Gently warm the surface of the balm with a fingertip or puff before use, then lightly tap it onto the areas you want to catch the light, such as the cheekbones, bridge of the nose, brow bone or cheeks. Do not rub hard over your base; tap lightly in thin layers for a natural glow and to minimise shifting your base. Can be used with a matte base for a subtle inner glow or with a glow base to boost a 360° radiant effect.

safety.text:
For external use on the cheeks only; avoid use on scratched or irritated skin
Discontinue use if any unusual signs appear, and keep out of reach of children.
